verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents a first-party Profiles feature that saves and reuses browser state across multiple sessions, including cookies, local storage, session storage and cache. That is the mechanism for keeping a logged-in state so later runs skip the login. The evidence is a single doc statement. missing for 10: explicit documentation of attaching profiles to agent tasks, guidance on profile lifecycle and management, independent or hands-on corroboration that saved logins persist reliably.

support.subject: As a developer, I can persist logged-in browser state in reusable profiles so agents skip the login wall on every subsequent run

citations.quote: Profiles let you save and reuse browser state, which includes cookies, local storage, session storage, and cache, across multiple sessions.
